== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[Shadow]] [[aura]] is a form of [[madra]] associated with the [[Akura clan]]. Unlike other powers such as [[blood]] or death, it is considered a natural element similar to [[wind]], though it possesses mysterious and difficult-to-define properties. It can manifest as a thick darkness that affects the environment, such as tinting the stars or creating physical barriers and terrain. A significant aspect of this power is the [[Blood Shadow]], a [[spirit]] that can be formed when an individual channels their own will into their [[spirit]]. While this process initially grants the [[Blood Shadow]] control over the user, it eventually evolves into a reflection of the user's own [[spirit]]. Users can manipulate these shadows in various ways: some maintain them as shifting, formless weapons, while others feed them the power of [[sacred beasts]] to create monstrous entities. A [[Blood Shadow]] can also be shaped into a pet, a clone of the user, or a specialized weapon. These entities are highly mutable and can take on the traits, appearance, and abilities of whatever they consume, including [[Life aura|life aura]] or the essence of enemies. They can also manifest physical attributes like extra limbs, teeth, or specialized weaponry to aid in combat.}}
